usage: This is the universal word for congratulations across the Levant. It is used for everything from major life events like weddings and graduations to everyday occurrences like getting a haircut or buying a new shirt. It is appropriate for all formalities, ages, and social groups.

variants.label: Intensified
variants.note: Used for major life milestones like weddings, having a baby, or graduating.

variants.label: To a man
variants.note: Used to specifically direct the congratulation to a single male.

variants.label: To a woman
variants.note: Used to specifically direct the congratulation to a single female.

variants.label: Formal / Religious
variants.note: A more formal or religious alternative, often used during Eid or Islamic occasions.

examples.english: Congratulations on the new car, it's amazing!

examples.arabic: أَلْف مَبْرُوك التَّخَرُّج، بِتِسْتَاهَل كِل خِير.
examples.transliteration: alf mabrouk t-takharroj, btestahel kel kheir.
examples.english: A thousand congratulations on graduating, you deserve the best.

examples.arabic: مَبْرُوك الزَّوَاج، إِن شَاء اللّٰه بِتْشُوفُوا السَّعَادَة.
examples.transliteration: mabrouk z-zawaaj, in sha allah btshoofou s-sa3adeh.
examples.english: Congratulations on the marriage, hopefully you will see happiness.
